summary: This sermon explores Philippians 2:3-11, arguing that successful Christian life and church are built on humility. The pastor walks through Paul's instructions on selfless service, Jesus' example of giving up divine privileges from incarnation to crucifixion, and the ultimate exaltation that results from humility.
key_points: Don't serve your own interests; selflessly serve others all the time
Three obstacles to humility: wealth, reputation/status, and strength
Jesus demonstrated perfect humility from his birth through his death on the cross
Christ gave up reputation, wealth, and divine privileges to serve humanity
True joy comes from Christ's exaltation, not from climbing society's ladder
big_idea: Successful Christian life and church are assembled with an attitude of humility that mirrors Christ, who gave up his divine privileges, reputation, wealth, and strength to sacrificially serve others.
title: Successfully Humility
